title: Felix and the Inventory
author: Vesper Yarrow
blurb: Odile Montrose, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
